title: Renovate triage verdict
description: Structured output contract for the analyze job in tooling/renovate-triage.yaml. The publish job fails the check if an instance does not validate.

verdict.description: Exactly one of the four triage verdicts. Closed enum: no other value is ever valid.

evidence.description: One URL per claim in summary: changelog, release, advisory, or govulncheck report.
